call_points.text: No EBITDA percentage or per-tonne guidance; management said absolute EBITDA will beat previous quarters.
₹1,500 Cr capex over 2-3 years, of which ₹700 Cr is already on the books; no new capital raise planned.
Raipur backward-integrated cold-rolled and coated steel line to be fully operational in 18 months; land acquired, construction begun.
Q1 volumes: 160,000 tonnes service centres, 18,000 tonnes steel profiles, 11,000 tonnes renewable structures.
Working capital days of 27 expected to fall to 20-25 within two years as backward integration cuts raw-material stocking.
Contract manufacturing being explored; details promised on the Q2 call, with no vertical allowed below 20% ROCE.

guidance.statement: Annualized EBITDA guidance of INR300 crores to INR350 crores for FY27
Absolute EBITDA of around ₹300 Cr for FY27, subject to no drastic macro deterioration
Revenue of ₹25,000-35,000 Cr by 2030 on more than 4 million tonnes of steel volume
Total capex of about ₹1,500 Cr over the next 2-3 years, funded from ₹700 Cr cash and operating cash flow
25 service centres by 2029, adding 5 every year
Working capital days to settle between 20 and 25 in the next 2 years

operating_notes.text: Working capital days reduced to 20 days with inventory and debtor rationalization in FY26.
Q1FY27 volumes were 160,000 tonnes from service centres, 18,000 tonnes steel profiles and 11,000 tonnes renewable structures.
EBITDA per tonne was ₹1,800-2,000 in service centres, ₹3,000-4,000 in steel profiles and ₹3,000-3,500 in renewable structures.
Inventory fell to ₹209 Cr at 30 June 2026 from ₹284 Cr at 31 March 2026 despite higher steel prices.
Acquired 100% equity interest in Tanwar Cargo Solutions Private Limited on August 3, 2026 for ₹75 crores.

timeline.summary: On April 25, 2026, SG Mart submitted the scrutinizer's report confirming shareholder approval for ESOP scheme amendments via postal ballot.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,822.84 Cr, net profit ₹41.47 Cr.
SG Mart Limited shared the audio recording link for its May 4, 2026, investor conference call discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 audited results.
Promoter Dhruv Gupta declared no encumbrance on SG Mart shares by promoters or PAC during FY2025-26, requesting Audit Committee disclosure on April 3, 2026.
On May 7, 2026, SG Mart submitted the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call.
On May 7, 2026, SG Mart submitted a Regulation 10(5) disclosure regarding the proposed inter-se transfer of 35.08% stake to Sameer Gupta via gift.
On May 27, 2026, SG Mart informed the exchange about an order from the Collector of Stamps, Delhi, demanding ₹1.89 Cr in stamp duty and penalty.

On its 20 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, SG Mart reaffirmed a ₹300 Cr FY27 EBITDA target and set a 2030 vision of ₹25,000-35,000 Cr revenue and at least ₹1,000 Cr EBITDA on over 4 million tonnes of steel volume, funded by ₹1,500 Cr capex with no dilution planned.
SG Mart posts Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,562 Cr and net profit of ₹54 Cr
SG Mart Limited provides link to audio recording of conference call held on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.
